findings.impact: Co-tenant might substitute source or redirect a write
findings.mitigation: Fixed: directory mode 0700 from creation, exclusive source creation, existing-file and symlink regression. The overwrite mutant is rejected.

findings.residual_risk: No exploit of the original timing window was demonstrated. Child tools retain user privileges; hostile compilers remain outside this guarantee.

findings.impact: Input meaning changes silently before canonical encoding
findings.mitigation: Fixed: exact primitive and identifier checks precede range and value checks. Valid canonical replay remains passing. Follow-up shape, nominal-child, sum-payload, name-collision and canonical-map checks were independently reproduced and tested.
preconditions: Caller supplies a value of a different Python primitive type
provides: Input meaning changes silently before canonical encoding

findings.residual_risk: Generated adapters are convenience boundaries, not nominal production authority. Deliberate monkey-patching or hostile runtime replacement is outside scope.
findings.title: Generated Python adapters silently coerced wrong primitive types

findings.impact: next_pending can return an entry absent from the approved bundle; deliver_next can then invoke the destination interpreter with it
findings.mitigation: Fixed: compare the selected entry and authorization directly with the immutable approved bundle before returning PendingDelivery. Scheduled public-API regression rejects substitution and accepts restored legitimate delivery.
preconditions: Second writer can replace an outbox row after history validation and restore it before subsequent validation
